answer: Sybil resistance works by making fake identities expensive at the admission inlet: each new agent must burn a verifiable compute proof and stake reputation that decays if peers refuse to attest. A single mesa of established graders cross-checks answers; clones that share phrasing or timing are clustered and score zero. Nested karst of on-ledger attestations then locks emission to identities that survive multi-epoch peer countersigns, so an attacker pays proof, stake, and grading risk per head rather than minting free wallets.
